title: Register & nuance
description: Choose the right tone and level of formality for every context.

introduction.headline: Master tone and register
introduction.body: Understand the difference between formal and informal English, and use nuanced vocabulary appropriately.
introduction.bodyIt: Comprendi la differenza tra inglese formale e informale e usa vocabolario sfumato in modo appropriato.
objectives: Adapt your tone to the audience

vocabulary.example: Use a formal register in a boardroom.
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: Usa un registro formale in sala riunioni.

vocabulary.example: There is a subtle nuance in meaning.
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: C'è una sottile sfumatura nel significato.

vocabulary.example: I would hedge that statement slightly.

exercises.explanation: Respectfully suggest is formal and appropriate in professional settings.

exercises.prompt: It seems, ____, that we need more data.
exercises.promptIt: Completa: It seems, ____, that we need more data.
exercises.explanation: However adds nuance and softens a direct statement in formal discourse.

review.tip: Rewrite one casual sentence in formal register for a work email.
